articles.title: Cisco Warns of Active Attacks Exploiting New Critical Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability
articles.summary:
Attackers are exploiting a critical flaw in Cisco Secure Email Gateway that lets a sender with no login write files to the appliance's operating system, Cisco said in an advisory on Wednesday.

articles.title: Multiple NGINX Flaws Let Remote Attackers Crash Servers and Execute Malicious Code
articles.summary:
F5 has disclosed three serious security flaws in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source that can let remote, unauthenticated attackers crash worker processes by sending crafted HTTP requests. In certain setups, the memory errors could also allow code execution, although F5 says that outcome requires Address Space Layout Randomization, known as ASLR, to be disabled […]

articles.title: Hackers Backdoor Nextcloud Servers Through Critical Flaw in Collabora’s Built-in CODE App
articles.summary:
Attackers exploited a flaw in an optional Nextcloud app, Collabora Online - Built-in CODE Server, to plant web shells on Nextcloud servers. Three administrators reported the issue on GitHub, with the first logged attack on September 10.

articles.title: 24 Security Vulnerabilities Patched in curl Used Across 30 Billion Installations
articles.summary:
The curl project released curl 8.23.0 on October 14, 2026, announcing 24 security fixes affecting the widely used data transfer tool and its underlying library, libcurl. The vulnerabilities include credential leaks, authentication errors, command injection, and flaws that can disrupt applications. articles.title: U.S. Shuts Down Over 40 Laptop Farms, Charges 14 in North Korean IT Worker Fraud
articles.summary:

articles.title: Microsoft’s Recent Windows Updates Break Remote Desktop Services With Error “0xC000000D”
articles.summary:
